notes:
New Features:

● Adds white divider lines to the Custom Site Settings window to clearly separate the tabs, settings area and OK/Abbrechen column.

● Redesigns Release Notes with an opaque background, white frame and structured New Features and Bugfixes sections with clearer bullet-point spacing and scrolling support.

Bugfixes:

● Simple IPTV Update now starts immediately without an unnecessary confirmation dialog.

● Keeps the successful IPTV update notification visible in front of the Settings window before reopening Settings.

● Changes tab hover handling to Kodi's mouse-move action path so the Settings tabs can switch when the mouse moves over them.
